useImagesForQa.description: Specifies whether to use images for question answering.

createLlmMessagesLambda.description:
The lambda to create the message we are passing to the LLM.
If {#useImagesForQa} is set to true, this field must be set to a lambda that takes a list of {@link Genai.SourcePassage}s
and returns a list of messages to send to llm.

Parameters to the lambda:

imageSpecs - The list of image specs to be used for contextual QA.

prompt - The formatted prompt to be used for the contextual QA along with passages.

returns the list of messages to send to llm.
